taxon.wikipedia_summary: Phillyrea latifolia, commonly known as green olive tree or mock privet, is a species of tree in the family Oleaceae.

page.title: Phillyrea latifolia
page.extract: Phillyrea latifolia, commonly known as green olive tree or mock privet, is a species of tree in the family Oleaceae. It is native to the Mediterranean Basin, from Morocco and Portugal in the west, to the Levant in the east.

page.title: Phillyrea latifolia
page.extract:
Phillyrea latifolia, commonly known as green olive tree or mock privet, is a species of tree in the family Oleaceae. It is native to the Mediterranean Basin, from Morocco and Portugal in the west, to the Levant in the east.
